claims.text: The document specifies one UTF-8 JSON-RPC object per LF line with protocol 2024-11-05, no response for notifications, and stdout reserved for protocol replies only.
The JSON-RPC error table maps invalid JSON, invalid request shape, unknown method, invalid params and internal failures to codes -32700, -32600, -32601, -32602 and -32603.
Live resources are served through the shared dispatcher as complete untrusted wrappers, reading verified ledger state and never cached agent or memory files.
Resume from memory requires independently retained observations for memory_bootcheck and a failed bootcheck stops action until reconciled, never synthesized from current state.

decision.rule: Change here when the MCP framing, error mapping, resource list or prompt set needs to change.
decision.failure: A domain failure returns a JSON-RPC error instead of isError, a live resource reads cached files, or a resume pass synthesizes bootcheck observations.

questions.q: Where are the MCP error codes and their meanings documented?
